versions.subject: Add rule for suspicious lolbin executing in non-c drive
versions.detection:
selection_lolbin:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'wscript.exe'
        - 'cscript.exe'
        - 'regsvr32'
selection_exetensions:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.js'
        - '.dll'
selection_drive_path:
    CommandLine|contains: ':\'
filter_drive_path:
    CommandLine|contains: 'C:\'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*wscript.exe*", "*cscript.exe*", "*regsvr32*") CommandLine IN ("*.js*", "*.dll*") CommandLine="*:\\*" NOT CommandLine="*C:\\*"
